cards.audioText: Can you say something about your corporate culture?
cards.audioTextZh: 能否介绍下你们的公司文化？
cards.referenceText: Yes. Hainan Airlines has been able to integrate the cultural essence of China with the latest Western scientific skills into its corporate culture. We are dedicated to be a modern cutting-edge airline.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。海南航空公司将中国文化精髓与西方科学技术融入到其企业文化中。我们致力于成为一家现代尖端的航空公司。

cards.audioText: If your flight is delayed, how do you comfort passengers?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你的航班延误了，你如何安抚你的旅客？
cards.referenceText: If my flight is delayed, I will tell passengers the situation through PA. I will try to take off as soon as possible so I will ask passengers to wait patiently.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果航班延误，我会做个机长广播告知旅客我们现在遇到的问题，我们会尽最大努力尽快起飞，请耐心等待。

cards.audioText: Do you think the communication among crew members is important? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你是否认为机组成员间的交流很重要？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Yes. Communication among crew members is very important. Because they are working as a team, if they have different ideas during flight, they must speak out to sort a common understanding of the problem. That will benefit their job.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的。机组成员间的交流非常重要。因为他们作为一个团队工作，如果在飞行中有不同的想法，他们必须说出来，达成共识。这将有利于他们的工作。

cards.audioText: Do you think team work is important in your work? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为团队合作在你的工作中是否重要？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I think team work is very important in my work. We have a special terminology for team work, which is CRM. I think CRM is very important for us especially during an emergency situation, because a better CRM can ensure the flight safety and decrease threats and errors.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为团队合作在我的工作中是非常重要的。我们用一个特别的术语来称呼团队合作，就是CRM。我觉得CRM对我们来说非常重要，尤其是遇到紧急状况时，一个好的CRM可以确保飞行安全，减少威胁和失误。

cards.audioText: How do you think of preflight inspection of the pilot?
cards.audioTextZh: 你怎样看待飞行员的飞行前检查？
cards.referenceText: I think preflight inspection of the pilot is just as important as preflight inspection of the aircraft. It is vital to ensure pilots' health at the highest possible level. Having a cold or other illness or taking prescription medicine can seriously affect pilots'ability to concentrate, thus affecting the flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为飞行员的飞行前检查和飞机的检查同等重要。在尽可能高的高度飞行，确保飞行员的健康是至关重要的。感冒及其它疾病，或是服用处方药都可能严重地影响飞行员的注意力，从而影响飞行安全。

cards.audioText: Assume that you are going to fly tomorrow, will you make any preparations today?
cards.audioTextZh: 假设明天你有飞行任务，你今天会做哪些准备吗？
cards.referenceText: If I will fly tomorrow, I will ask for the following information of destination airport: the condition of airport, the location, the runway condition, the departure and approach frequency. I also need to know the condition of surrounding alternate airport, the route, the alternate airport of departure/destination airport and the weather condition en route.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果明天我有航班任务，我首先会要了解一下目的地机场的情况，地理位置，跑道情况，进离场以及一些频率。周边备降机场的情况，所飞的航路。以及起飞机场备降机场和目的地机场以及航路上的天气情况。

cards.audioText: What is the role of normal checklists?
cards.audioTextZh: 正常检查单的作用是什么？
cards.referenceText: Normal checklists enhance flight safety by providing an opportunity to confirm that the safety critical aspects of the systems and aircraft configuration are correctly set. By following normal checklists, any mistakes in settings will be identified and corrected before they may cause safety problems. Normal checklist actions, as with all SOPs, are intended to check or verify actions that were accomplished from memory. A defined flow pattern should be employed for each cockpit panel. Safety-critical points should be cross-checked through the use of normal checklists.
cards.referenceTextZh: 正常检查单通过检查系统的安全关键部分和飞机配置是否设置正确来加强飞行安全。按照正常检查单，设置中出现任何错误都会在其造成安全问题前被发现并纠正。按照标准运行程序执行正常检查单是为了检查或确认是否所有记忆的项目都已经完成。驾驶舱操作面板应配备标准巡视流程。为了保证飞行安全应对正常检查单进行交叉检查。

cards.audioText: What would you suggest for flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对维护飞行安全有什么建议？
cards.referenceText: Now we are too busy with flight duty and always feel tired. As we all know, fatigue will endanger flight safety, I want to have more time to relax myself, and it's good for my health. So, I think more holidays should be arranged for pilots.
cards.referenceTextZh: 目前我们忙于飞行任务，总会觉得累。大家都知道，疲劳驾驶会危及飞行安全，我想要有更多的时间放松自己，这对我的健康也是有益处的。我认为应该为飞行员安排更多的假期。

cards.audioText: When using contaminated fuel, what might be the consequences?
cards.audioTextZh: 使用受污染的燃油可能会导致什么结果？
cards.referenceText: Contaminated fuel may affect engine performance and cause engine problem, or even cause damage to the engine, which will increase the operational risks during flight. Therefore, in preflight inspection, we must follow the checklist to check the fuel.
cards.referenceTextZh: 受污染的燃油可能会影响发动机性能，导致发动机出现问题，甚至会损坏发动机，从而增加飞行中的运行风险。因此，在飞行前检查中，我们必须严格按照检查单要求来检查燃油。

cards.audioText: Please make a brief introduction to the airline you are serving in.
cards.audioTextZh: 请简单介绍下你所在的航空公司。
cards.referenceText: OK. I am from China Southern Airlines. It' s the newest member of Sky Team with main flight operations based at Guangzhou Baiyun International AirPort, Beijing Capital International Airport and Zhengzhou Xinzheng International Airport. China Southern Airlines has 13 branches located throughout China and 54 international offices located in major metropolitan markets around the world. It' s one of China' s best-known airlines.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。我来自中国南方航空公司。它是天合联盟的最新成员，主运营基地分布在广州白云国际机场、北京首都国际机场以及郑州新郑国际机场。中国南方航空公司有13家分公司遍布全国，并在世界各地主要城市有54个国际办事处。它是中国最知名的航空公司之一。

cards.audioText: What are the advantages and disadvantages of flying domestic routes?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞国内航线的优缺点分别是什么？
cards.referenceText: When flying domestic routes, I can go home more often, and spend much more time with my family and friends, and the pressure is relatively less for me, but I have less opportunities to learn aviation English with different accents around the world. Domestic routes are short, flying domestic routes is a high-demanding and challenging work. Pilots need to acquire the flight skill and knowledge of routes firmly.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞国内航线时，我可以经常回家，有更多的时间和家人朋友在一起，而且对我来说压力较小。但是和世界各地不同口音的人交流、练习英语的机会就少了。国内航班距离短，工作强度大，富有挑战，同时飞行员需要更好的掌握飞行技术以及航线知识。

cards.audioText: How do you think delays are more common at larger airports than smaller ones?
cards.audioTextZh: 你怎样看待大型机场比小型机场更容易发生延误的情况？
cards.referenceText: I think it is understandable that there are more flight delays at larger airports than smaller ones, because there is too much traffic at larger airports and too many passengers to handle every day.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为大型机场比小型机场更容易延误是很合理的，因为大型机场交通流量大，每天都要处理很多乘客事宜。

cards.audioText: What will happen if CG is put a little bit forward of aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果飞机重心略靠前会发生什么？
cards.referenceText: If CG is put a little bit forward, the aircraft nose would be too heavy and it would be hard to operate the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果重心略靠前，机头过重，飞机将很难操纵。

cards.audioText: What are the advantages and disadvantages of flying international routes?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得飞国际航线的优缺点分别是什么？
cards.referenceText: Flying international routes, I can travel around the world and take some opportunity to practice my English, as well as learn more different culture around the world. But the requirement for international flying is higher and more challenging. During flying, pilots may suffer from Jet-lag, high intensity flight and high altitude hypoxia. Meanwhile, pilot also have to adapt to different environment, climate and culture. It is the basic literacy of a qualified pilot to adapt to diverse environments.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞国际航线，我可以周游世界，并有机会练习英语，还可以感受世界各地的不同文化。但是飞国际航线的要求更高，更具有挑战性。时差、高强度飞行以及高空缺氧状态都是飞行中可能遇到的问题。同时飞行员还需要适应不同的环境、气候、文化等。适应多元的环境，这也是一名合格飞行员的基本素养。

cards.audioText: Why do you choose to be a pilot?
cards.audioTextZh: 你为什么选择成为一名飞行员？
cards.referenceText: Because I'm very proud to be a pilot. Being a pilot offers me a good opportunity to travel and to see the world. I have been to many places, Europe, America, Asia, and so on. I have met people of different backgrounds and have experienced their cultures. All these are valuable experience for me.
cards.referenceTextZh: 能成为一名飞行员我感到自豪。当飞行员提供给我一个环游世界的机会。我去过很多地方，欧洲、美洲、亚洲等。我遇到过许多不同背景的人，体验了他们的文化。这些经历对我来说都是很宝贵的。

cards.audioText: What are the advantages when flying at high altitudes?
cards.audioTextZh: 客机在高空飞行的优点是什么？
cards.referenceText: Aircraft will consume less fuel at higher altitudes, because less power is required at higher altitude due to thin air. Besides, cruising high can avoid some interference like birds, helicopters or other aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机在较高的高度飞行消耗的燃料较少，因为高空空气稀薄，需要的功率较低。另外，在高空巡航可以避免鸟类、直升机或其它飞机的干扰。

cards.audioText: What action would you perform if your TCAS is out of work during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中如果交通警告和防撞系统失灵你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: I will fly away from RVSM airspace and request a lower altitude to operate. Meanwhile I will ask ATC for special assistance and request a safer separation to assure flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会飞离RVSM空域，并请求在较低高度飞行。同时，我会像ATC请求特别援助，并要求安全隔离，以确保飞行安全。

cards.audioText: Can you make a brief introduction of TCAS?
cards.audioTextZh: 能否简单地介绍下TCAS？
cards.referenceText: Yes. TCAS is shorted for traffic collision avoidance system, which is an aircraft collision avoidance system aimed to reduce the incidence of mid-air collisions. Most big airplanes use TCAS. It automatically monitors the airspace to avoid conflicting traffic by vertical movement or level change. TCAS reduces the pilot's workload and the rate of aviation accidents, and it has greatly improved flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。TCAS是空中防撞系统的英文缩写，是旨在减少中空碰撞的飞机防撞系统。大多数大型飞机都使用TCAS。它可以自动监控空域，以避免因垂直或水平变化引起的交通冲突。TCAS减少了飞行员的工作量及航空事故的概率，大大地提高了飞行安全。

cards.audioText: As a captain, what will you do in a hijack?
cards.audioTextZh: 作为机长，遇到劫持你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: We have detailed procedures to deal with hijack, so if there is hijack, I think I'll follow the procedures in the Operation Manual. I must keep calm and squawk 7500 without being noticed. Then I will report our situation to ATC if possible. If the hijacker wants to destroy the aircraft, I think the most important thing should be making sure the safety of the passengers and aircraft. During the whole process, I will make every command firmly, and every crew member should work well with each other.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们有详细的操作程序来应对劫持，所以如果遇到劫持，我想我会按照操作手册中的程序解决。我必须保持镇定并趁其不备发送编码7500。如果可以的话，我会把情况报告给ATC。如果劫机者想要毁坏飞机，我觉得最重要的还是保证乘客及飞机的安全。整个过程中，我会坚决地执行每个命令，机组成员间也应互相合作。

cards.audioText: Do you think flying at higher altitude can save more fuel?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为在更高高度飞行能节省更多的燃油吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I think so. Generally speaking, at higher level, air density is less than that of lower level, the plane gets more lift with less thrust, so flying at higher level is more fuel-efficient. But it doesn't mean the higher the better, while cruising at high altitude, we may encounter severe weather conditions such as severe turbulence or severe icing, it may increase the fuel consumption. So the altitude must be around the optimum altitude, which can help to save fuel.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我认为能。一般来讲，高度越高，空气密度越低，飞机能够在较小的推力下得到更大升力，因此在更高的高度飞行时省油，但并不是说越高越省油，当在更高高度飞行时，我们可能会遇到强烈的湍流或严重积冰等恶劣天气，这样反而会增加燃油消耗，因此，飞行高度应该是在最佳飞行高度范围内，这样才能够节省燃油。
